You can {{Color|Buzz|recycle W-Engines}} to obtain related materials.}} '''Box Galaxy''', also known as the '''Gadget Store''', is a [[Shop]] run by [[Susie]] and her boss in [[Sixth Street]]. ==General== Box Galaxy is a store that specializes in selling [[W-Engine]]s, offering a variety of B-Rank W-Engines and a small selection of A-Rank W-Engines. Additionally, the store has a Database tab where players can check out information on various W-Engines at a glance. Purchasing W-Engines not only requires [[Denny|Dennies]], but also a resource known as [[W-Engine Chip]]s, which are acquired by dismantling W-Engines and from clearing [[Notorious Hunt]]. The store also has a Recycle tab, allowing players to dismantle unwanted W-Engines to acquire [[W-Engine EXP Material]] and W-Engine Modification Material, along with a small amount of Dennies. ==Shop== {{Shop|shop=Box Galaxy|currency=Denny |(Identity) Base ;;type{{=}}W-Engine ;;
